claims.evidence: No import sticker, customs mark, or shipping label visible in any photo; origin cannot be confirmed from a static image.
No bench-test video, multimeter reading, or voltage/amperage display shown; only static photos of the housing.
Noise cannot be assessed from photos; would need an audio/video clip of the unit running.
Alternators carry no mileage odometer; no donor-vehicle documentation or mileage sticker is shown.
No close-up of housing screws, seals, or tamper marks to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Internal wear: bearings, brushes, or diode pack may be degraded despite external cleanliness.
risks.proof: Bench-test video showing stable voltage output under load and no abnormal noise.
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested/worst-case, assume possible internal fault

risks.risk: Electrical output rating may not match buyer's vehicle (voltage/amperage).
risks.proof: Clear photo of stamped part number or spec label on housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unmatched/generic unit, buyer bears compatibility risk

risks.risk: Connector plug or pulley groove count may not fit buyer's car.
risks.proof: Close-up of connector pin layout and pulley groove count with vehicle comparison.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incompatible, needing adapter or pulley swap

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion or water ingress from claimed overseas import history.
risks.proof: Close-up interior shot or photo of mounting points/terminals for rust or residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having undisclosed corrosion risk

risks.risk: Seller's 'Tokunbo/Belgium' sourcing claim may be fabricated to inflate perceived quality.
risks.proof: Import documentation, customs tag, or seller's sourcing invoice.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard used local-market part, no import premium

proof_requests: Video of alternator running on a test bench showing voltage output and sound
Close-up photo of any stamped part number, brand, or spec label on the housing
Close-up photo of the electrical connector pins and pulley groove count
Photo of housing screws/seals to confirm it hasn't been opened
Any import/customs documentation supporting the Belgium origin claim
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used car alternator with no verifiable brand, rating, or test proof, so it must be priced at worst-case condition pending the listed evidence.
